scientific_wording_correction.basis: Prior 26 Nov source audit C2-IND-01; author manuscript, Sections3.4–3.5, pp19–21. Manuscript-to-version-of-record equivalence remains unverified.
scientific_wording_correction.before:
The digital twin study maps sensor features to robot TCP positions, showing how position can
establish correspondence even if it is not, in any normal sense, a predictive feature
\parencite{Chen2023Multisensor}.
scientific_wording_correction.after:
In the inspected author manuscript, the digital twin study maps sensor features and prediction
outputs to robot TCP positions. These positions provide spatial registration; they are not among
the 27 listed sensor features \parencite{Chen2023Multisensor}.
